Class.name: IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.TCP.Adapter.CustomFramedTcpOutBoundAdapter
Class.Description: This class only overwrites the WriteFramedStream so that start and end frame block are sent in single packet along with actual stream All other behaviour is inherited from EnsLib.TCP.FramedOutboundAdapter

Method.name: WriteFramedStream
Method.Description: Write the stream contents as a framed block on the TCP socket (logs errors except for <WRITE> error.) This method will call the WriteFramedStream of superclass so that the framing is sent int the same packet as actual content **** Do not use this where stream size can be greater than 32K
Method.Implementation: Set tSC=$$$OK //Set ..Terminators = ..AsciiOrHexAsChars(..MessageFrameEnd) $$$TRACE("MessageFrameEnd"_..MessageFrameEnd) $$$TRACE("MessageFrameStart"_..MessageFrameStart) //Set ..MessageFrameEndAsChars = ..createStartAndEndFrom(..MessageFrameEnd) //Set ..MessageFrameStartAsChars = ..createStartAndEndFrom(..MessageFrameStart) #dim tmpStream As %Stream.Object set tmpStream=##class(%GlobalCharacterStream).%New() $$$TRACE("MessageFrameEndAsChars1:"_..MessageFrameStartAsChars) $$$TRACE("MessageFrameStartAsChars1"_..MessageFrameEndAsChars) do tmpStream.Write(..MessageFrameStartAsChars_pStream.Read()_..MessageFrameEndAsChars) do tmpStream.Rewind() set tSC=##super(tmpStream,pCharset,pInbound,0) Quit tSC
